title: Punjab Chief Minister to Launch Education Initiatives in Attock
excerpt: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif is scheduled to visit Attock to announce new education programs and laptop distribution.
body_html:
Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz Sharif is scheduled to visit Attock on Tuesday. During the visit, she plans to announce and launch multiple education initiatives.

The upcoming programs will include a laptop distribution scheme covering two additional districts. Further details regarding the rollout and the specific education projects will be shared during the official launch event in the region.
